caption: The drawing features two representations of a three-legged figurine with a human-like upper body. On the right, there is a large, darkly-shaded, detailed rendering of the figurine, showing a smooth texture and clear contours. The figurine has a head with facial features, a slender torso, and two arms bent at the elbows and joined at the middle of the body. Its legs are thick, curved, and splayed outward, giving it a tripod-like stance. To the left of this main figure is a smaller, less detailed, and more lightly shaded outline of the same figurine. This outline includes minimal facial features and simplified body lines, and it is accompanied by a horizontal scale marked in inches for size reference. The artist’s name, "Mildred Ford," is written in neat letters at the lower right corner of the drawing. The background is light, and no additional colors or objects are present.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
